messages:
Maya: Urgent: pushing a hotfix for embed-proxy in prod-us because some partners saw embedding timeouts. Patch fixes a connection pooling bug. Image: `embed-proxy:1.8.4-hotfix3`. We're in a constrained late change window. Requesting expedited approval and asking whether we should skip canary and do traffic-shift directly. @Priyash @Carlos @infra_alerts pls weigh in.
Priyash: Can you quantify customer impact? Skipping canary is risky unless impact is severe.
Maya: Errors: 502/timeout for embed requests -> affects approx 2% of partner traffic, retries are noisy and amplify downstream latency. Staging with load tests shows the fix resolves 99% of the failures. Time sensitivity: partners are reporting production incidents.
Carlos: If partner SLA is failing, we can consider a fast-path but prefer a tiny canary (5%) for 5 mins. We should also have rollback playbook ready.
infra_alerts: Alerting page already created: https://redwood.internal/alerts/embed-proxy-timeout. I'll keep on-call monitoring and set a PagerDuty escalation if partner error-rate > 1.5% post-deploy.
Maya: Rollback steps (if needed):
```
# manual image rollback
kubectl -n prod-us set image deploy/embed-proxy embed-proxy=embed-proxy:1.8.4
# deploybot fallback
deploybot rollback --service embed-proxy --to-tag 1.8.4 --note "rollback after hotfix regression"
```
Maya: Proposal: start at 5% canary for 3 minutes with synthetic partner traffic check; if green -> 25% for 4 minutes; green -> 100% cutover. If any TLS/connectivity/502 spike -> immediate 5-min pause and rollback.
pm_ravi: From PM side, communicate to partners after cutover. I can send an interim message that were doing a quick patch. Keep me in the loop.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary requested for embed-proxy:1.8.4-hotfix3 in prod-us (5% traffic) at 1761130030. Canary checks: health, 502_rate, conn_pool_metrics.
Carlos: Approve 5% canary. Keep me posted at each stage.
Priyash: Approve the staged plan. One extra ask: enable debug logging for 5 minutes in canary to capture failures if any.
Maya: Will enable debug logs for canary pods. Commencing canary now.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary progress: 5% -> 25% at 1761130100. Health checks passing; 502_rate from 2.1% -> 0.3% on canary slice; partner-synthetic latency within expected.
Maya: Noted improvement on canary. Moving to 100% with caution. Keeping rollback window 10 mins after 100% for observation.
infra_alerts: I've wired an alert rule to escalate on 502_rate > 1.0% across prod-us for 10m. I'll also create a dashboard panelling canary/primary slices.
deploybot: [deploybot] Rollout to 100% completed at 1761130188. Post-rollout checks: all green except a minor p95 latency +4% on specific region.
Priyash: That p95 delta is within expected due to transient warm-up. Approve final.
Carlos: Approve final. Good catch enabling debug logs  we have traces if anything crops up.
Maya: Post-deploy notes: partners seeing reduced timeouts in initial telemetry. Keeping enhanced monitoring for 30m. PM @pm_ravi will send partner note after we confirm stability.
pm_ravi: Drafting partner note: "We deployed a hotfix to embed-proxy to address intermittent timeouts. Initial telemetry shows reduced errors; monitoring continues. No action required from partners. We'll update if anything changes."
infra_alerts: Leaving monitoring on and handing over to standard oncall once the 30m enhanced window completes.
Maya: Marking this thread resolved for now. If we see any regressions we'll re-open and file a short postmortem. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
